content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for District Court SBS Nagar Clerk Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://districts.ecourts.gov.in/nawanshahr. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 13-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the District Court SBS Nagar Clerk recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the District Court SBS Nagar Clerk recruitment is 13th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Clerk post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Degree of B.A./B.Sc or equivalent from a recognized University, have Punjabi language as a subject in their Matriculation examination, and demonstrate proficiency in computer operations.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Clerk position?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Clerk post is a minimum of 18 years and a maximum of 37 years as of 1st August 2026. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per rules.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Clerk post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 13 vacancies announced for the Clerk post by the District Court SBS Nagar.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Clerk post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Clerk post will receive a salary as per Pay Matrix Level-5 of the 7th Central Pay Commission.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to send their application forms to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. What are the selection stages for the Clerk recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Clerk post includes a Written Test and a Computer Proficiency Test/Computer Typing Test.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for the Clerk post?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Clerk post in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of District Court SBS Nagar, the link for which is provided in the Important Links section.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for this recruitment is Ad-hoc.
